movie.title: The Gentleman Thief
movie.overview: A retired master thief must protect his impulsive brother from disaster when a 100 million dollar yacht heist spirals into a dangerous web of deception. Old foes emerge as the stakes rise, forcing him to use every trick he knows to stay alive.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A retired master thief must return to a dangerous world of high-stakes crime and betrayal to save his reckless brother following a $100 million yacht heist gone wrong.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: When a daring $100 million yacht heist jeopardizes his reckless brother's life, a retired master thief is pulled back into the perilous underworld he left behind. Navigating a treacherous web of intrigue and deceit, he must outsmart old enemies who have resurfaced to settle past scores. To ensure their survival, he relies on the cunning skills and experience that once made him legendary. Ultimately, he faces a desperate fight where loyalty and survival are put to the ultimate test.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: After leaving his life of crime behind, a legendary master thief enjoys a quiet retirement until his impulsive brother gets entangled in a high-stakes job. The reckless youth targets a luxury yacht, orchestrating a daring $100 million heist that quickly spirals out of control. Forced out of retirement to protect his family, the veteran thief steps into a dangerous web of deceit and shifting alliances. As he investigates the aftermath of the robbery, old enemies from his past resurface, eager to settle long-standing grievances. Tensions escalate rapidly as dead ends and double-crosses reveal that the heist was far more complex than a simple robbery. Relying on his unmatched cunning, veteran instincts, and old tricks, the master thief meticulously plans a strategy to outmaneuver his ruthless rivals. Every move becomes a high-stakes chess match where a single mistake could prove fatal for both brothers. As the pressure reaches a boiling point, he must confront his past decisions while risking everything on one final, dangerous game. In a heart-pounding struggle against time and deadly foes, he fights to break free from the criminal underworld once and for all.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Gentleman Thief is a high-octane thriller centered on a retired legendary burglar forced back into action when his hotheaded brother pulls off a perilous $100 million yacht heist. Plunged into a dangerous web of deceit, old rivalries, and sudden betrayals, the veteran thief must utilize his sharp intellect and cunning skill set to outwit deadly enemies and safeguard his family.

story_structure.risingAction: Old enemies resurface and tensions mount as the protagonist uses his elite skills, cunning tricks, and past experience to navigate escalating betrayals and threats.
